coverage_definition.full: Substantive complete text, or read canonical plus exhaustive all-content transformation/delta review. Reconstruction full is distinguished from literal full.
coverage_definition.alias: Exact bytes only. canonical_status governs semantic completeness; alias of classified is not read.
coverage_definition.classified: Named excluded family/ownership; no read or runtime success claim.
